complianceFlags.notes: No listing on the OMRI Products List (searched 2026-10-08: 'Sphaerex', 'metconazole', 'prothioconazole'; no Sphaerex product). Conventional DMI premix; label makes no organic statement.

notes: BASF FRAC 3 + 3 DMI premix (EPA label 2022-02-25). Wheat, barley, oats, rye and triticale: 7.3 fl oz per acre for head scab (head blight), applied during early flowering with forward and reverse facing nozzles, at least 10 gpa by ground. At most 7.3 fl oz per application, 14.6 fl oz per acre per year and 2 Group 3 applications per year; 14 day retreatment interval; 30 day PHI. Early season sprays do not control head scab.
